about: Steps each skill asks of the owner, per basic flow, measured on real QA runs. Unmeasured values are null and the page prints "not measured yet". Never fill a value from an estimate: every number needs measured_on and run_ref. Retries and extra steps go in notes, not in the counts. owner_interactions.total counts openkey_approvals + pastes + choices + codes_typed; leave total null unless all four were observed. Parts seen in a run whose total is unknown go in partial, which the page does not print. agents lists every agent the page tracks, in column order (ids as in the onboarding eval and PR #61). A flow's own fresh and returning cells are "any agent": runs that did not record the agent. by_agent.<agent id>.fresh and .returning are the same cells for one agent; the onboarding eval writes them with `node run.mjs --matrix`, from passing runs only (failing runs go in notes, never in numbers). Those cells add case (the golden case), runs (passing runs used) and timing, in whole seconds, medians over those runs: time_to_approval_s (run start to the first OpenKey link), approver_s (the test approver, from opening the link to handing the code over), time_after_approval_s (code handed over to the agent's last reply), total_s (run start to the agent's last reply), link_to_done_s (first link to last reply, approver included), code_copy_s (the gap before the agent's command that carries the pasted code: the test approver hands over OpenKey's full code, a person pastes the short one), agent_tool_calls and agent_turns (for the whole run). timing describes the whole run the cell was measured in; a value the run did not record is null. A skill's time_to_done names the flow whose agents' timing.total_s the page shows in its "Time to done" row.
